beats.care: These athletes are some of India's most successful sportspeople. Following them is a quick way to see para sport's rise.
beats.what: The Asian Para Games opened in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, on 18 October and run until 24 October, with Indian athletes in several sports.
beats.why: India won a record 111 medals, including 29 golds, at Hangzhou in 2023. This time quotas are tighter and chess and canoeing are gone.

cards.body: Names to follow include Sheetal Devi and Harvinder Singh in archery, Sumit Antil in athletics, Avani Lekhara in shooting and Pramod Bhagat in badminton. Harvinder won India's first Paralympic archery gold at Paris 2024.
Chess and canoeing gave India 12 medals in Hangzhou but aren't in these Games, and India isn't sending teams in taekwondo or rowing.

hook: Can India's para athletes beat *111 medals* with a smaller team?

learn.t: India's para athletics squad was roughly halved, from 123 athletes in 2022 to 62, because of smaller quotas.
